name: vorizon
description: Vorizon — AI Employee Platform (build, train, test & deploy AI employees for inbound/outbound calls)

scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n server,client -c blue,magenta "npm run dev --workspace @vorizon/server" "npm run dev --workspace @vorizon/client"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace @vorizon/server && npm run build --workspace @vorizon/client
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspace @vorizon/server && npm run typecheck --workspace @vorizon/client
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test --workspace @vorizon/server
